instruction: Candid studio portrait, medium close-up. Against a plain light grey studio background, three women embrace closely. On the left, the straight-haired woman (R1) in a white strap top looks forward with a soft smile. In the center, the freckled woman with an afro (R3) in a light blue top smiles warmly at the camera, her hand resting on R1's shoulder. On the right, the curly-haired woman (R2) in a dark strap top leans in, looking at the camera with a slight smile. Soft, diffused studio lighting illuminates their faces, creating a warm, intimate atmosphere with neutral tones.
elements: R3 rests her hand on R1's shoulder
R1 receives R3's hand on her shoulder
R2 leans in close to the group
R3 is the central participant in the close embrace
